desc: Ideation complete and candidate approaches documented.
Implement and verify the 16-state binary-relation DFA DP with precomputed transitions and multiplicities, including sample tests.
If the DFA fails sample tests, debug transition composition/acceptance or build a small brute-force oracle to identify the mismatch.
Optimize the DP for N=10^6 using fast input, active-state iteration, and minimal modulo operations.
Check edge cases such as all zeros and all ones.
